items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Dipper Mile played, yeah. Dipper Mile? Yeah, he used to play them all the time he used to play.

ctx.x: What tunes would he play? What tunes he said would he play?

He played both something E, A, D, and C, and uh, S-4. He said, do you know the name of any of the tunes he used to play? No. Well he used to play all them pieces like Maple Leaf Rag, Black and White Rag, and uh, let me see what that other one, and the piece with uh, Kit Oliver used to play. That's a kind of some kind of blues, ain't it? You know where they make all them stops, ain't it? Dipper Mile played, yeah. Dipper Mile? Yeah, he used to play them all the time he used to play. Ask me if you knew Rabbit from…
It was Rabbit, he used to play Gitto and sing.
